verdict: FEASIBLE — a 600-clip distribution-matched val can be drawn from the remainder
caveat: The remainder is the RESIDUE of a manoeuvre-balanced selection, so it is systematically POORER in junctions/turns/stops than the train set it must mirror. Matching therefore OVERSAMPLES the scarce strata, which SHRINKS the effective independent sample on exactly the manoeuvres that matter most. Report the per-stratum headroom, never just the total N.
